title: alkalmazás, online, regisztrál: Doing Things Online

sections.title: Words for an app
sections.content: An *alkalmazás* is an app. Most things you do in one, such as booking, ordering and paying, use verbs you already know: *foglal* (Unit 15) and *fizet* (A1). The new words are *regisztrál* ("to register, to sign up"), *rendel* ("to order") and the adverb *online*, which never takes an ending. Two endings you know do the rest: *-val/-vel* for "by card" (*kártyával fizetek*, from A1) and *-ban/-ben* for the place you do it in (*az alkalmazásban*).

items.english: I book a table in the app.

items.spanish: Ebédet rendelek online, és kártyával fizetek.
items.english: I order lunch online and pay by card.
First I register, then I book a ticket.

sections.content: *online* is an adverb, so it takes no ending: *Online fizetek*. The app is a place you are inside, so it is *az alkalmazásban*. And you pay *kártyával* ("with the card"), never *kártyán* ("on the card").
